title: Index lists a second melody (LHym 437) of 'Eia mater' for 15/9 L, but the feast page names only LHym 436: load it as an option?
prompt: The Index hymnorum (p1217) has two rows 'Eia mater 15/9 L', one with LHym 436 (#116 → gregobase:17970, mode 2) and one with LHym 437 (#117 → gregobase:17969, mode 6). The feast page p887 (Die 15: B. M. V. Perdolentis) prints only 'Laudes H Eia Mater (LHym 436)', with no 'vel' (compare p67 'Candor æternæ (LHym 19 vel 21)', which loaded as option 2 'vel (LHym 21)'). #116 holds our-lady-of-sorrows LAUDS.hymn option 1, so #117 is held as a conflict. The same pattern probably applies to 'Stabat mater 2' (#300, still queued in conflicts).

options.label: Load as option 2, option_txt 'Alia melodia (LHym 437)'
options.detail: the index assigns it to 15/9 L; the page simply doesn't repeat the second melody. Rule applies to every index-only second melody

options.label: Don't load
options.detail: only what the feast page names is loaded; #117 stays identity-only

options.label: Swap
options.detail: check whether 17969 rather than 17970 is LHym 436 (the page's melody)
